meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会深度解析古诗词的意象、情感、表现手法与文化背景，生成2-3组配图场景描述，并输出Suno格式的配乐创作蓝图（风格标签+结构指令），同时检查视觉与听觉风格的统一性。
howto.when: 当用户需要为古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词MV时触发；用户提供诗词标题、作者和内容后，Claude按步骤开始创作指导。

say.text: 为《静夜思》生成配图方案和Suno配乐蓝图
say.note: Claude会解析意境并输出配图和蓝图层层递进

say.text: 给王维《山居秋暝》做配图配乐，用中国风
say.note: 会生成传统山水画风格和相应音乐结构

say.text: 把《春望》做成MV，先解析再出视觉听觉方案
say.note: 会整合配图与配乐，统一情绪曲线

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will deeply analyze the imagery, emotions, techniques, and cultural background of classical poems, produce 2-3 scene descriptions for illustrations, and provide a Suno-format music blueprint (style tags + structure instructions), while checking visual-audio consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask for illustrations, music, or MV creation for classical poems; after receiving title, author, and content, Claude follows the steps to create.

say_en.text: Generate illustration options and a Suno music blueprint for 'Quiet Night Thoughts'.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes mood and outputs visuals plus blueprint.

say_en.text: Create illustration and music for Wang Wei's poem in Chinese style.
say_en.note: It gives traditional painting style and matching music structure.

say_en.text: Turn 'Spring View' into an MV; analyze then design visuals and audio.
say_en.note: It integrates both tracks and aligns emotional curves.
